sqls.sql: INSERT INTO TEST_TASK_LIST ( TASK_ID, TASK_TYPE, DTL_TYPE, DEVICE, SYS_RECD_CRET_DT, TASK_ADR, TEST_STATUS, TEST_RESULT, ERR_MSG, RUN_DATE, REQ_PROD_SEQ, EXE_CD, PREF_RANK, CHORD_ID, CHORD_NM, CHORD_TYPE, CHORD_SBST, RESERVE_DATE, RESOURCE, SYS_TRTR_ID ) VALUES ( :task_Id, :task_Type, :dtl_Type, :device, :sys_Recd_Cret_Dt, :task_Adr, :test_Status, :test_Result, :err_Msg, :run_Date, :req_Prod_Seq, :exe_Cd, :pref_Rank, :chord_Id, :chord_Nm, :chord_Type, :chord_Sbst, :reserve_Date, :resource, :sys_Trtr_Id )
UPDATE TEST_TASK_LIST SET TEST_STATUS = :test_Status, TEST_RESULT = :test_Result, ERR_MSG = :err_Msg, RUN_DATE = :run_Date WHERE TASK_ID = :task_Id

SELECT TASK_ID, TASK_TYPE, DTL_TYPE, DEVICE, SYS_RECD_CRET_DT, TASK_ADR, TEST_STATUS, TEST_RESULT, ERR_MSG, RUN_DATE, REQ_PROD_SEQ, EXE_CD, PREF_RANK, CHORD_ID, CHORD_NM, CHORD_TYPE, CHORD_SBST, RESERVE_DATE, RESOURCE, SYS_TRTR_ID FROM TEST_TASK_LIST WHERE TASK_TYPE <> 'RESERVATION' ORDER BY SYS_RECD_CRET_DT DESC, TASK_ID DESC

SELECT TASK_ID, TASK_TYPE, DTL_TYPE, DEVICE, SYS_RECD_CRET_DT, TASK_ADR, TEST_STATUS, TEST_RESULT, ERR_MSG, RUN_DATE, REQ_PROD_SEQ, EXE_CD, PREF_RANK, CHORD_ID, CHORD_NM, CHORD_TYPE, CHORD_SBST, RESERVE_DATE, RESOURCE, SYS_TRTR_ID FROM TEST_TASK_LIST WHERE TASK_TYPE = 'RESERVATION' ORDER BY SYS_RECD_CRET_DT DESC, TASK_ID DESC

SELECT TASK_ID, TASK_TYPE, DTL_TYPE, DEVICE, SYS_RECD_CRET_DT, TASK_ADR, TEST_STATUS, TEST_RESULT, ERR_MSG, RUN_DATE, REQ_PROD_SEQ, EXE_CD, PREF_RANK, CHORD_ID, CHORD_NM, CHORD_TYPE, CHORD_SBST, RESERVE_DATE, RESOURCE, SYS_TRTR_ID FROM TEST_TASK_LIST WHERE TASK_TYPE <> 'RESERVATION' AND TEST_STATUS = 'RDY' ORDER BY SYS_RECD_CRET_DT, TASK_ID

SELECT TASK_ID, TASK_TYPE, DTL_TYPE, DEVICE, SYS_RECD_CRET_DT, TASK_ADR, TEST_STATUS, TEST_RESULT, ERR_MSG, RUN_DATE, REQ_PROD_SEQ, EXE_CD, PREF_RANK, CHORD_ID, CHORD_NM, CHORD_TYPE, CHORD_SBST, RESERVE_DATE, RESOURCE, SYS_TRTR_ID FROM TEST_TASK_LIST WHERE TASK_TYPE = 'RESERVATION' AND TEST_STATUS IN ('RDY', 'WAIT') ORDER BY RESERVE_DATE, TASK_ID

SELECT TASK_ID, DATA_SEQ, ACT_TYPE, ACT_RESULT, ACT_STATE, ELM_ID, INPUT_VALUE, DELAY_TIME, CAPTURE_IND, ACT_SBST, ACT_NO, ACT_RST_SBST, ELM_TAG, ELM_NM, ELM_TYPE, ELM_SEQ, ELM_CLASS, INNER_TEXT, ERROR_CLASS, ERROR_MSG, PAGE_NO, TARGET FROM TEST_TASK_DTL WHERE TASK_ID = :task_Id ORDER BY DATA_SEQ, ACT_NO

SELECT TASK_ID, DATA_SEQ, ACT_TYPE, ACT_RESULT, ACT_STATE, ELM_ID, INPUT_VALUE, DELAY_TIME, CAPTURE_IND, ACT_SBST, ACT_NO, ACT_RST_SBST, ELM_TAG, ELM_NM, ELM_TYPE, ELM_SEQ, ELM_CLASS, INNER_TEXT, ERROR_CLASS, ERROR_MSG, PAGE_NO, TARGET FROM TEST_TASK_DTL WHERE TASK_ID = :task_Id AND DATA_SEQ = :data_Seq AND ACT_NO = :act_No

INSERT INTO TEST_TASK_DTL ( TASK_ID, DATA_SEQ, ACT_TYPE, ACT_RESULT, ACT_STATE, ELM_ID, INPUT_VALUE, DELAY_TIME, CAPTURE_IND, ACT_SBST, ACT_NO, ACT_RST_SBST, ELM_TAG, ELM_NM, ELM_TYPE, ELM_SEQ, ELM_CLASS, INNER_TEXT, ERROR_CLASS, ERROR_MSG, PAGE_NO, TARGET ) VALUES ( :task_Id, :data_Seq, :act_Type, :act_Result, :act_State, :elm_Id, :input_Value, :delay_Time, :capture_Ind, :act_Sbst, :act_No, :act_Rst_Sbst, :elm_Tag, :elm_Nm, :elm_Type, :elm_Seq, :elm_Class, :inner_Text, :error_Class, :error_Msg, :page_No, :target )

UPDATE TEST_TASK_DTL SET ACT_RESULT = :act_Result, ACT_STATE = :act_State, ACT_RST_SBST = :act_Rst_Sbst, ERROR_CLASS = :error_Class, ERROR_MSG = :error_Msg WHERE TASK_ID = :task_Id AND DATA_SEQ = :data_Seq AND ACT_NO = :act_No

INSERT INTO TEST_COMM_LIST ( META_KEY, UPR_DIV_KEY, SYS_RECD_CRET_DT, DIS_NM, ALIAS_NM, META_VALUE, VALUE_DESC ) VALUES ( :meta_Key, :upr_Div_Key, :sys_Recd_Cret_Dt, :dis_Nm, :alias_Nm, :meta_Value, :value_Desc )

UPDATE TEST_COMM_LIST SET SYS_RECD_CHG_DT = :sys_Recd_Chg_Dt, DIS_NM = :dis_Nm, ALIAS_NM = :alias_Nm, META_VALUE = :meta_Value, VALUE_DESC = :value_Desc WHERE UPR_DIV_KEY = :upr_Div_Key AND META_KEY = :meta_Key
SELECT META_KEY, UPR_DIV_KEY, SYS_RECD_CRET_DT, SYS_RECD_CHG_DT, DIS_NM, ALIAS_NM, META_VALUE, VALUE_DESC FROM TEST_COMM_LIST WHERE UPR_DIV_KEY = :upr_Div_Key ORDER BY META_KEY
SELECT META_KEY, UPR_DIV_KEY, SYS_RECD_CRET_DT, SYS_RECD_CHG_DT, DIS_NM, ALIAS_NM, META_VALUE, VALUE_DESC FROM TEST_COMM_LIST WHERE UPR_DIV_KEY = :upr_Div_Key AND META_KEY = :meta_Key
